notes.title: Super Seducer 2 out now (discount for buyers of SS1)
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Super Seducer 2 is out today and we have arranged a launch discount AND an additional discount for buyers of the original :)

Get it here 

1.  Super Seducer 2 is much longer, with 16 hours total play-time.
2.  SS2 is much better - we have a bigger and better cast, more varied scenarios, and everything looks and sounds better. 
3.  The advice and seduction tactics are turned up and cover a wider range of common questions that single guys have.  

Overall we tried to add more of what you loved in the first game, and fix anything that you said could be better!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/863570/Super_Seducer_2/

Finally, I want to thank all of you for supporting this franchise :)

Rich
